text.en: You've been unemployed for a while. The only interviews you get are for junior roles that pay half of what you used to make.
text.zh: 你失業有一段時間了。能約到的面試全是初級職位，薪水只有以前的一半。

text.en: Take the junior role. Pride is a luxury you can no longer afford.
text.zh: 接下初級職位。尊嚴已經是你負擔不起的奢侈品。

text.en: Keep hunting for something closer to your old level. Another month of savings burns.
text.zh: 繼續找接近舊職級的工作。又燒一個月存款。

text.en: A senior director slot opens. You've been corporate for years. The panel asks if you're 'still hungry'.
text.zh: 出現一個資深總監空缺。你在正職待了好幾年。面試官問你「還有沒有餓」。

text.en: Show the hunger. Accept longer hours and the new title.
text.zh: 展示飢餓感。接受更長工時和新頭銜。

text.en: Stay at your current level. Sleep still exists.
text.zh: 留在現職。睡眠還存在。

text.en: A recruiter DMs you: '+30% base, fully remote, and we actually mean it.' Your current boss still thinks 'remote' is a temporary phase.
text.zh: 獵頭私訊你：「底薪+30%，全遠端，而且是真的。」你現在的老闆仍認為「遠端」只是過渡期。

text.en: Jump. Update LinkedIn the same afternoon.
text.zh: 跳槽。當天下午就更新 LinkedIn。

text.en: Stay loyal. Ask for a matching raise. Receive a 'market review' in six months.
text.zh: 留下盡忠。要求對等加薪。得到「六個月後市場檢視」的回覆。

text.en: You and a peer are both up for the same senior role. They once told you about their side consulting. You still have the chat logs.
text.zh: 你和一位同儕競爭同一個資深職位。對方曾告訴你私下接案的事。你還留著對話紀錄。

text.en: Leak the logs. Friendship is a junior-level skill.
text.zh: 洩漏紀錄。友情只是新手村技能。

text.en: Compete clean. Lose with dignity (and a fruit basket).
text.zh: 光明正大競爭。輸得體面（還有一籃水果）。

text.en: Interest on your debts now exceeds your monthly grocery budget. The bank calls it 'standard amortization'. You call it a slow bleed.
text.zh: 債務利息已經超過每月買菜錢。銀行稱之為「標準攤還」。你稱之為緩慢失血。

text.en: Cut everything non-essential. Live like a student again.
text.zh: 砍掉所有非必要開支。重新過學生生活。

text.en: Take a second job on weekends. Sleep becomes optional.
text.zh: 週末再兼一份工。睡眠變成可選項。

text.en: Private school just raised tuition another 12%. The principal emails about 'investing in excellence'. Your spreadsheet calls it a catastrophe.
text.zh: 私立學校學費又漲 12%。校長來信談「投資卓越」。你的試算表稱之為災難。

text.en: Pay it. Your child's future > your retirement number.
text.zh: 照繳。孩子的未來 > 你的退休數字。

text.en: Switch to public. Prepare for the guilt campaign at the dinner table.
text.zh: 轉公立。準備迎接飯桌上的愧疚攻勢。

text.en: Your parent can no longer live alone safely. Siblings are 'very busy' but full of opinions.
text.zh: 父母已無法安全獨居。兄弟姐妹「都很忙」，但意見很多。

text.en: Move them in. Learn the true meaning of patience.
text.zh: 接回家住。重新認識「耐心」二字。

text.en: Pay for a care facility. Carry the guilt for free.
text.zh: 出錢送照護機構。愧疚感免費附贈。

text.en: Chest tightness at 2 a.m. ER says 'probably stress' but still orders a full workup 'just in case'.
text.zh: 凌晨兩點胸悶。急診說「大概是壓力」，但仍安排完整檢查「以防萬一」。

text.en: Do every test. Start changing habits tomorrow.
text.zh: 全部檢查。從明天開始改習慣。

text.en: Skip the extras. 'I'm fine' is still a powerful spell.
text.zh: 拒絕額外檢查。「我沒事」仍是強大咒語。

text.en: You've been at the same level for six years. A 29-year-old with better hair and a podcast just got the promotion.
text.zh: 你在同一職級待了六年。一個頭髮比較好、有播客的 29 歲年輕人剛拿到升遷。

text.en: Smile, congratulate, update résumé at 1 a.m.
text.zh: 微笑祝賀，凌晨一點更新履歷。

text.en: Ask for a raise. They offer 'more visibility'.
text.zh: 要求加薪。對方給「更多曝光機會」。

text.en: Your side project is finally making money. Your main job has noticed the 'reduced enthusiasm'.
text.zh: 你的副業終於開始賺錢。正職卻注意到你「熱情下降」。

text.en: Quit the day job. Bet on the side project.
text.zh: 辭掉正職，把一切押在副業上。

text.en: Kill the side project. Sleep becomes possible again.
text.zh: 關掉副業。睡眠重新變得可能。

text.en: You and your partner mostly communicate through logistics and sighs. Someone suggests couples therapy.
text.zh: 你跟另一半的溝通幾乎只剩物流安排和嘆氣。有人建議去夫妻諮商。

text.en: Go. Say the hard things out loud on the couch.
text.zh: 去。坐在沙發上把難聽的話說出來。

text.en: Book a weekend trip instead. Hope proximity helps.
text.zh: 改訂週末旅行。希望距離近一點能修好。

text.en: Your new boss is 27, communicates in emojis, and calls quarterly reviews 'vibe checks'.
text.zh: 你的新老闆 27 歲，只用表情包溝通，還把季度考核叫「氛圍檢查」。

text.en: Learn the slang. Say 'no cap' with a straight face.
text.zh: 學黑話。一臉嚴肅地說「no cap」。

text.en: Say 'back in my day…' and watch HR take notes.
text.zh: 說「想當年……」，看著 HR 開始做記錄。
